授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
コース融合プロジェクトでは、「プラットフォーム（課題）」に対して、学年や所属コースの異なる学生が共同でその課題に取り組み、これまで身に付けた専門分野の知識やスキルを用いて問題解決に取り組む方法を学ぶと共に、別の専門分野の知識やスキルを経験することで、従来のデザイン領域の枠を超えた広範なデザインスキルや知識の習得を図る。
本プロジェクトでは、食べものや食事という行為、食糧の生産をデザインの対象と捉え、多様な食品の調理や、ゲストによるレクチャー、さまざまな調理器具を用いた制作を通じて、私たちの日常において最も身近かつ重要な表現としての“食 (food)”にまつわる、様々な穀物の観点を踏まえた未来のデザインのあり方を、批評的に検討する。食と穀物という観点から、文化の多様性、宗教、法、といったデザインを取り巻く様々なトピックへの入り口として、食に関わる実践を通じて、従来のデザイン領域の枠を超えた広範なデザインスキルや知識の習得を図る。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
In the project, students from different grades and course affiliations work together on a "platform (problem)" and learn how to solve the problem using the knowledge and skills they have acquired so far in their specialized fields, while also gaining experience in the knowledge and skills of other specialized fields, thereby acquiring a broad range of design skills and knowledge beyond the conventional. The project aims to help students acquire a broad range of design skills and knowledge that go beyond the boundaries of their traditional design field.
This project considers food, the act of eating, and food production as objects of design, and will critically examine the future of design informed by perspectives on various grains as the most familiar and important expression in our daily lives, through the preparation of a variety of foods, lectures by guests, and production using various cooking utensils. From the perspective of food and grains, the course will serve as a gateway to various topics surrounding design, such as cultural diversity, religion, and law. Through food-related practices, students will acquire a wide range of design skills and knowledge that transcends the boundaries of conventional design fields.
